summary.text: SMF subsidies cover several home healthcare items, including diapers, catheters, milk feeds and wound dressings.

details.heading: Covered items
details.body: Adult diapers; catheters and catheter sets; milk feeds; nasal tubing; nasogastric tubes and pH indication test strips; thickeners; and wound dressings.

example_phrasings: What consumables are covered under SMF?

sources.page_title: What consumables are covered under SMF?

quotes.text: You can use SMF subsidies for the following types of consumables (also known as home healthcare items):
Adult diapers Catheters and catheter set Milk feeds Nasal tubing Nasogastric tubes and pH indication test strips Thickeners Wound dressings
